Merge the 60160-case short-source dispatcher into the existing 30448-case CPU-only census, retaining distinct control contexts while reducing duplicate instruction admissions and shifted-field interior repetition: 90608 scheduled inputs become 44656 (before counting duplicate bundled tails). DRSUB, long-pair, logic-short and XORM retain their positive checks but no longer repeat the rejection tail; the stack profile's atomic prefix was already covered by default. This deletes the old phase-owned fixture and its state entirely.
